chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

When you fast, let your hearing and your sight fast from the unlawful and the reprehensible. Leave argumentation and harming the servant. Let the dignity of the fasting person be upon you, and do not make the day of your fast like the day of your breaking the fast.

key_terms.أَذَى: harm or injury done to others
key_terms.الْحَرَامِ: that which is forbidden by Allah
key_terms.الْقَبِيحِ: what is morally ugly or reprehensible
key_terms.بَصَرُكَ: your sight, which must be guarded from the unlawful
key_terms.سَمْعُكَ: your hearing, which must be restrained during fasting

ai.seo_question: What are the etiquettes of fasting according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that fasting is not limited to abstaining from food and drink, but includes restraining the senses and conduct from haram and ugly behavior. It emphasizes spiritual discipline, dignity, and ethical self-restraint as essential etiquettes of sawm.
